needed_lemma: Exact finite LP/conic primal-dual bound, KKT/Slater qualification, Farkas infeasibility certificate, or rigorously enclosed numerical certificate used inside an analytic optimal-threshold argument.
unproved_interface: Finite optimization certificates do not by themselves prove compactness of the probability-law/strategy spaces, minimax exchange for the original model, threshold attainment, or uniform validity over distributions.

needed_lemma: Validate a finite-horizon or finite-state LP/MIP dual bound and independently check rational/interval arithmetic in computed examples.
unproved_interface: A finite certificate does not establish the model-specific arrival-order convention, tie/atom handling, measurability of a policy, continuum feasibility, or passage from finite n to an asymptotic bound; these remain separate analysis obligations.

needed_lemma: Check the finite optimization subproblem and distinguish weak duality from strong duality/attainment; use exact or interval certificates for numerical lower/upper bounds.
unproved_interface: Relaxation bounds and solver outputs do not establish exactness of a moment/SOS/SDP relaxation, universal validity, or a limit interchange absent their individual hypotheses.
